journey.name: E2E-01: Agent 网关插件安装、账号配对与双向消息收发全流程闭环
journey.description: 端到端验证由 Android CLI 驱动的完整流程：从网关连接表单输入、TLS 握手协商、账号凭据认证配对，跃迁至主工作台时间线，完成上行消息编辑发送、状态防抖以及下行流式响应呈现全闭环。

actions.action: Verify that the "连接你的 Agent Gateway" title is visible on screen
Click the "网关地址" input field
Type "https://10.0.2.2:8045" into the "网关地址" field
Click the "用户名 / 账号" input field
Type "e2e_tester" into the "用户名 / 账号" field
Click the "访问凭据 / 密码" input field
Type "GatewaySecretPass2026!" into the "访问凭据 / 密码" field
Verify that the login screen transitions and the main workbench top bar is visible
Click the message input field "输入消息或 / 命令..."
Type "Hello Agent, E2E full lifecycle test message." into the input field
Verify that the message input field is cleared
Verify that the user message appears in the message timeline
